CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   D. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   B. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   D. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   C. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.
   C. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   D. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social Media 3 Total Number of Lessons 90 Note: The suggested number of lessons  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain My purpose Talents and abilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
